verdict.rationale: Ledgy's API exposes only a narrow set of operations (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) for reading cap table/transaction data, whereas the UI supports a vastly broader set of actions (granting equity, bulk workflows, financial reporting, compliance management, trading/settlement, HRIS sync). No evidence the API allows write actions or covers most UI functionality. Missing for 10: API endpoints for granting/administering share plans, financial reporting generation, compliance workflows, trading/settlement operations, and any documented OpenAPI spec (probes show 404s) confirming full API surface parity.
